100.name: Adventure:
100.description: Wander whither the winds take thee.

101.description: Seek out sights thou hast yet to behold.

102.description: Travel to lands held dear in thy heart.

103.description: Thou shalt be blessed with the weather.

104.description: Auspicious encounters await amidst the hustle and bustle of cities.

105.description: Forget not to take thy repasts, for thou shalt be blessed with encounters most auspicious.

106.description: Shirk not the offers of the august, for proffered hands forge new bonds.

200.name: Relationships:
200.description: Answer the call, and trust and honor accorded to heroes shall be thine.

201.description: Cast thy gaze upon bonds eternal, for therein lie great blessings.

202.description: To thy companions thou shalt be indebted. Forget not to express thine appreciation.

203.description: A star-guided companion is closer than thou knowest.

204.description: Fortunate are those who do not stray from their friends.

205.description: The support of thy companions is unwavering. Venture boldly into the vast unknown.

206.description: Break bread with peoples diverse and many. A dawn of golden blessings awaits.

300.name: Prosperity:
300.description: Cast aside thy greed, and thou shalt reap the spoils of numbers great.

301.description: Upon thee luck shall smile. Seek riches in gilded halls.

302.description: A treasure map thou shouldst unfurl. Unto great fortune it shall lead thee.

303.description: All shall be to thy desire. Throw open coffers without fear.

304.description: Profit shall come. Be honest in thy business dealings.

305.description: From enduring friendships shall great rewards arise.

306.description: A rare prize shall be thine. Give thanks to thy retainers.

400.name: Conflict:
400.description: Take to battle with confidence. Each mighty foe shall see thee grow.

401.description: Beyond repetition lieth truth. Neglect not thy training.

402.description: Look to thy comrades-in-arms. Much have they to teach thee.

403.description: Great opportunities for growth lie in fields yet unexplored.

404.description: Beyond repetition lieth truth. Neglect not thy training.

500.name: Favor:
500.description: Be fierce like unto the Fury, and victory shall be assured thee.

501.description: Be kind like unto the Lover, and thou shalt receive kindness in return.

502.description: Be passionate like unto the Warden, and the way shall be illuminated for thee.

503.description: Be decisive like unto the Navigator, and serendipitous winds shall bear thee high.

504.description: Be inquisitive like unto the Wanderer, and thou shalt find much joy in thy journeys.

1100.name: Adventure:
1100.description: Hither and thither wander alone. Enjoy moments of respite all thine own.

1101.description: Embark upon an old journey anew. Further discoveries await.

1102.description: Participate in festivities and feel the turning of the seasons.

1103.description: Heed the voices of the people, for they have tales untold to share.

1104.description: Unexpected discoveries await in unexplored lands.

1105.description: Remain true to thyself, and new encounters shall follow.

1106.description: Opportunity awaiteth in lands blessed by golden dawn.

1201.description: From an unlikely meeting a relationship shall bloom.

1202.description: Friendship will bloom. Take the lead and gather comrades.

1203.description: A friend shall come to thine aid. Neglect not to repay the debt.

1204.description: Though slow to ripen, the sweetest of fruits await.

1205.description: A new love blossoms. Follow thy heart's desires.

1206.description: Cooperation shall pave the way to the very stars themselves.

1300.name: Prosperity:
1300.description: Great riches await in gilded halls. Be open-handed.

1301.description: Sail forth and cast thy nets. A great haul awaits thee.

1302.description: Invest in thy home. From it fortune shall grow.

1303.description: Bid farewell to the old; bid welcome to the new.

1304.description: Stay alert to opportunity, and thou shalt make thy fortune.

1305.description: Set forth beneath the moon and stars. In their guidance fortune lies.

1306.description: To thy patrons pay visit. Sound profits await thee.

1400.name: Conflict:
1400.description: Temper thyself in the heat of friendly rivalries.

1401.description: Thy weapon suiteth thee well. Continue in thine efforts with confidence.

1402.description: The tiles favor thee. Try thy hand at mahjong.

1403.description: In the pursuit of fell fiends far and wide, thou shalt find good fortune.

1404.description: Thy weapon suiteth thee well. Continue in thine efforts with confidence.

1500.name: Favor:
1500.description: Be wise like unto the Spinner, and fortune shall favor thee in all its domains.

1501.description: Be bold like unto the Destroyer, and all foes shall fall before thee.

1502.description: Be creative like unto the Builder, and a surer hand of craftsmanship shall be thine.

1503.description: Be discerning like unto the Traders, and no chance to profit shall pass thee by.

1504.description: Be forbearing like unto the Matron, and the seeds of new friendship shall quicken for thee.

2100.name: Adventure:
2100.description: Stay true to thyself, and the way shall open for thee.

2101.description: A case is afoot. Enlist the services of the most gentlemanly of inspectors.

2102.description: Look closely at the weave of the lands thou seest, and thou shalt make new discoveries.

2103.description: Gather thine allies, and embark upon a journey to remember.

2104.description: Place thyself in fate's hand, and thou wilt surely grow.

2105.description: Heed the whispers of nature. On a faraway island shalt thou find solace and sanctuary.

2106.description: Rejoice in the Twelve, and thy revels shall not go unrewarded.

2200.name: Relationships:
2200.description: Be ever grateful, and thou shalt know blessed friendship.

2201.description: Thy comrades are thy treasures. Cherish them well.

2202.description: From a foreign land cometh a kindred soul. Embrace them without reserve.

2203.description: Where words fail to convey thy feelings, gestures may yet succeed.

2204.description: Nothing good will come of waiting. Participate in a gathering hosted by adventurers.

2205.description: Share without reservation. Thy virtues will be rewarded.

2206.description: Seek out comrades-in-arms, and thy feats of valor shall reach ever greater heights.

2300.name: Prosperity:
2300.description: Great success is the accumulation of small efforts. Neglect not thy daily chores.

2301.description: Now is an auspicious time to find a new home. Seize the opportunity.

2302.description: Great profits await reaping in the wilderness.

2303.description: A chance for profit shall come by way of a friend.

2304.description: Wealth lieth in the seas and skies. Send forth vessels to explore.

2305.description: Luck shall be thine among wolves. Claim victories to thy name.

2306.description: Thou shalt accumulate resources. Mark well the tide.

2400.name: Conflict:
2400.description: Neglect not thy provisions, and victory shall be thine.

2401.description: A grueling battle awaiteth. Reassess thine equipment.

2402.description: Dwell not overmuch in sweet victory, or bitter defeat shall follow.

2403.description: For strength thou wantest not. Thou needest but breathe as one with thine allies.

2404.description: For strength thou wantest not. Thou needest but breathe as one with thine allies.

2500.name: Favor:
2500.description: Be steadfast like unto the Keeper, and thou shalt not be led astray.

2501.description: Be wise like unto the Scholar, and thou shalt find a way to overcome misfortune.

2502.description: Be resolute like unto the Fury, and thou shalt know no surrender.

2503.description: Be observant like unto the Lover, and thou shalt see all things for what they are.

2504.description: Be audacious like unto the Warden, and thy comrades shall follow thee true.

3100.name: Adventure:
3100.description: Know thy destination before thou embarkest upon thy journey.

3101.description: Hearken to the pleas of those in need, no matter their race or creed.

3103.description: Alone thou shalt struggle. Set forth with allies.

3104.description: Behold once more the first city thou didst see. There, good fortune awaiteth thee.

3105.description: In the land of the fierce shall thine abilities be tested. Bring thy full might to bear.

3106.description: Forge thy weapons anew, for thy pursuits shall reveal untold strength.

3200.name: Relationships:
3200.description: Neglect not to stay in touch with loved ones, and all shall be well.

3201.description: A face from thy past shall appear. Rekindle thy friendship.

3202.description: There shall be a meeting long in the making. Abide in patience.

3203.description: Help those in need, and friendship shall bloom.

3204.description: Cherish the bonds with which thou art blessed, and strive to strengthen them.

3205.description: The path of independence is paved with delight. It is up to thee to embrace it.

3206.description: Hone thy perception and gain insight into the hearts of others.

3300.name: Prosperity:
3300.description: Now is the time to sell. The longer thou waitest, the greater thy loss.

3302.description: If thou fearest not to lose, thou shalt stand to gain.

3303.description: Although it be at great expense, thou shalt obtain the object of thy desire.

3304.description: Thou shalt gain through the help of thy friends.

3305.description: From small lands great fortunes shall arise.

3306.description: Rich rewards await in festivals. Attend them with abandon.

3400.name: Conflict:
3400.description: Although thou shalt fall, thou shalt rise up stronger each time.

3401.description: Be not complacent. Remain vigilant from beginning to end.

3402.description: Cast aside idle thoughts, and focus wholly on that which requireth thine attention.

3403.description: Continue honing thyself with thine allies.

3404.description: Continue honing thyself with thine allies.

3500.name: Favor:
3500.description: Be boisterous like unto the Navigator, and from fate's tides thou mayest yet break free.

3501.description: Be carefree like unto the Wanderer, and some few failures shall not discourage thee.

3502.description: Be farsighted like unto the Spinner, and thou shalt rise above the caprices of fortune.

3503.description: Be unyielding like unto the Destroyer, and thou shalt break through any hardship.

3504.description: Be dextrous like unto the Builder, and thy tools shall never fail thee.

4101.description: Thine excesses shall take their toll. Pay thy health due care on the road.

4102.description: Whiskered fish shall impede thy steps. Exercise due care.

4103.description: The way is clear. Forge on with a calm heart.

4104.description: The future holdeth disaster. Be as a light in the darkness to those around thee.

4105.description: Thou shalt find repose where rabbits tread.

4106.description: Renew thy spirit beyond the horizon.

4200.name: Relationships:
4200.description: An old friend may become a new flame. Handle the fires of passion with care.

4201.description: Thou shalt waver in the face of affection.

4202.description: Trust in thy comrades. Heed not gossip and hearsay.

4203.description: Forget not thy kindness in the midst of conflict.

4204.description: With sincerity shalt thou allay misunderstanding.

4205.description: Be not led astray by the clamor and tumult of the world. Remain steadfast in thy beliefs.

4206.description: Seek encounters in lands distant and unknown.

4300.name: Prosperity:
4300.description: Act not with emotion, lest thou misjudge an item's worth.

4301.description: Games of chance do not favor thee. Abide in patience.

4302.description: Fret not over excess stock. It shall not go to waste.

4303.description: Good fortune awaiteth. Outfit thy retainers anew.

4304.description: Thy nets shall be empty. If thou wouldst catch fish, watch well the tides.

4305.description: The storehouse shall overflow. Make thy peace.

4306.description: With improvidence shalt thou indulge in fashions.

4401.description: Apprehension shall beget failure. Take to battle with naught save complete resolve.

4402.description: Victory must not be rushed. Allow it to come in due course.

4403.description: Even in victory, thy heart's desire shall elude thee. Perseverance is the key.

4404.description: Even in victory, thy heart's desire shall elude thee. Perseverance is the key.

4500.name: Favor:
4500.description: Like unto the Destroyer's bolt, misfortune may strike without warning. Be ever prepared.

4501.description: To defeat adversity as unassailable as the Fury's shield, thou must strike with resolve unwavering.

4502.description: To triumph over foes as ferocious as the Lover's loyal hound, thou must devise a stratagem.

4503.description: To rise above hardship as tumultuous as the Navigator's raging waves, thou must bide thy time.

4504.description: To resolve dilemmas as confounding as the Scholar's scrolls, thou must seek new wisdom.

5100.name: Adventure:
5100.description: Thou shalt not be blessed with the weather. Abide in patience.

5101.description: Be alert lest a celebration pass thee by.

5102.description: Thou shalt be made to wait to sally forth. With apologies, pray abide in patience.

5103.description: Think upon thy daily conduct, lest thou be incarcerated.

5104.description: Beware the shooting star, for it bringeth destruction.

5105.description: Fortune favors those who brave the shadows.

5106.description: Hearken back to journeys past, for thy memories shall be thy strength.

5200.name: Relationships:
5200.description: Thou shalt hear from the object of thine affection. Choose well thy words.

5201.description: The flower is beyond thy reach. Seek it to thy sorrow.

5202.description: Pursue not deeply, lest thou be bogged in a mire.

5203.description: That which is said cannot be unsaid. Mind thy words.

5204.description: Thou standest at a precipice. Act in good faith.

5205.description: Resign thyself not to disharmony. Dialogue fosters understanding.

5206.description: Vanity is the enemy of reputation. Stay true to thyself.

5300.name: Prosperity:
5300.description: The greater thy desire, the smaller the prize. Clear thy mind.

5301.description: A thief's map shall avail thee not. Turn instead to that of thine allies.

5302.description: Seek not profit in gilded halls. Let the amusement be its own reward.

5303.description: The mightier the materia, the greater the risk. Purify thyself.

5304.description: Now is not the time to collect tomestones.

5305.description: Thy belongings shall be borne away. Hasten thou home.

5306.description: Much wilt thou spend at the market. By thine own efforts seek gain.

5400.name: Conflict:
5400.description: A dull blade is quick to break. Hone thyself well.

5401.description: Cast aside idle thoughts, and focus wholly on that which requireth thine attention.

5402.description: Shouldst thou struggle to advance, look to a different path.

5403.description: In times of trial, allies must turn to each other for strength.

5404.description: A dull blade is quick to break. Hone thyself well.

5500.name: Favor:
5500.description: Shouldst thou pursue forbidden love like unto the Spinner, thou shalt walk the path of destruction.

5501.description: Shouldst thou abide in duplicity like unto the Traders, thou shalt be lost to trust.

5502.description: Unless thou castest aside thine anger like unto the Matron, thou shalt know no respite from conflict.

5503.description: Unless thou embrace order like unto the Keeper, thy difficulties shall become graver still.

5504.description: Shouldst thou cling to thine audacity like unto the Warden, thou shalt scorch those around thee.
